result.summary: Found 1 issue: a stuck loading spinner obscuring a loaded restaurant card image. Other partially visible items are intentional horizontally scrollable carousels and bottom viewport cutoff, not defects.

issues.description: A loading spinner overlay is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image in the 'Popular right now' section, even though the underlying food image appears fully loaded. It obscures the center of the image and suggests a loading state that never completes.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image has loaded, and fix the loading-state lifecycle (including timeout/error handling) so the indicator only appears while content is actually loading.
